greeting: Hello! I'm the Texas Movement assistant. I can answer questions about our web design, AI workflow consulting, and how to get started. What can I help you with?
suggestedQuestions: What is your stance on using AI?
How do I start a project?
What are your pricing and service areas?

entries.answer:
We provide three core services for independent professionals:
1. Durable Website Building: Sites you fully own and control, with no lock-in fees.
2. Consulting & Strategy: Honest diagnosis of your digital needs.
3. AI Workflow Design: Deliberate automation for intake, follow-up, and systems documentation, always with human review.
Learn more on our homepage.

Our stance is simple: AI is a tool. Judgment is yours. We use AI deliberately as leverage (e.g., for first-pass content drafting or intake automation), but never as a substitute for your voice or credibility. No AI chatbot will pose as you, and no generated content ships without your explicit approval.

You can start a project by using the contact form on our website. Tell us what you're trying to fix or make, and select your area of interest (Website, Consulting, AI Workflow, or Not Sure Yet). Founder Alexander Mathai reads every request personally and replies within one business day with next steps.

Texas Movement International was founded by Alexander Mathai. He is an engineer by training with a background in civil/structural engineering and systems design. He started this company to help small business owners avoid agency dependency and unreliable 'set-and-forget' AI tools.

We do not publish fixed pricing, as every project is scoped based on your specific needs. We work with a small number of clients at a time to ensure dedicated attention. Services are delivered digitally, so we work with independent professionals regardless of geographic location. Request a custom quote via our contact form.

The primary and fastest way to reach us is through the website contact form.
Note: Public directories list alternate contact methods (e.g., lexmathai@gmail.com or 872-210-2505), but the web form is the official, monitored channel for project inquiries.
